category_edits.rationale: Weaker attenuation may preserve useful signals from common history items across all four datasets. Retain the square-root normalized log training-count feature and zero values for unseen items. The generated predictor imports this same model class and restores its feature buffer, so the transformation stays identical during training and inference.

change_summary: Reduce training-frequency input attenuation from 0.3 to 0.2 for all four category models, preserving embeddings, NextItNet topology, readout, loss, optimizer and single-checkpoint prediction.
